title: Good for about three months
text: Good for about three months. Loved these pans for about three months.  Bought the full set.  After about three months, pans started to scratch and everything stuck to them.  I only used plastic or wood utensils...never anything sharp.  Called about guarantee and was told I did not register the product withing the specified time frame.  Pans were not expensive, so I guess you get what you pay for.
